(pa)༄༅/ /dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/bla

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa'i thabs kyis bsgrub bya ba// bsgrub phyir grub pa mchog gyur par// btud de rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i// dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// de la 'khor lo bde mchog gi phyi dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pa lung dang man ngag mnos pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ lam nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ nub mo chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang la nyal/ tho rangs nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra yi ge bdun pa'i sngags su grags pas gnyid bslangs nas he ru ka'i skur langs la/ snod bcud thams cad yang rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du blta'o// spro na dbang gi skabs ltar khrus bya/ de nas gnas dben par 'dug la/ skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ba'i phyir he ru ka bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ bdud rtsi ri lu myangs la/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog tu bsgom pa lus lhar bskyed pa sku'i dga' ba'o// shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes brjod nas/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// don de dang ldan pa ni bdag nyid do zhes dran pa ni ngag sngags su byin gyis brlabs pa gsung gi dga' ba'o// snying gi nang du a rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de las byung ba'i zla ba dag pa 'jig rten pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo'i steng du/ hūm̐ bsams pa'i zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su bsgom pa ni sems ye shes su byin gyis brlabs pa thugs kyi dga' ba'o// de las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa thams cad dag

ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i lus la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis gnas pa'i spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa spyan drangs te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥs dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas/ lha rdzas kyi mchod pa dpag tu med pa so sos mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes thams cad la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pre āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo phul ba ni phyi'i mchod pa'o// de nas dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod nas se gol brdab bo// yang snying gar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ā brta ho/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a bhisma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta māṃ/

sarba ta thā ga ta pa ri sho dha le/ maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dzñā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na/ ban+dha swas+thā na ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas yang se gol brdabs nas yid kyi mchod pas mchod nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la gus pa'i yid drag tu byas pas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor de dag rang gi lus la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang gi lus cig car dkyil 'khor du gyur par dmigs nas rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ spyi bo sna tshogs rdo rje/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib log rdo rje'i rwa ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i drwa ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor dang*/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ skal tshigs ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab gyi stod kyi cha/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba sgo bzhi/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang rnams ka ba'i tshogs te rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte ba'i hūm̐ dang*/ phyi'i he ru ka cig car gsal gdab ste pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du 'khor lo bde mchog zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bltabs nas mnan pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yon ljang*/ rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhal rnam par 'gyur ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon gos su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pas gri gug drug pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/

drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon na tshes gcig gis zla ba dang*/ mtshog ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo/ rna cha/ mgul rgyan/ gdu bu/ ska rags/ thal chen gyi rgya ste rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje ngam dang zhi ba ste// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra grol ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing*/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khril pa'o// snang ba dang thabs dang lhag mthong dang snying rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang shes rab dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing*/ zung du 'jug pa'i phyir kun tu kha sbyor ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// snying gi phyogs bzhi g.yon skor gyis lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ gnas pa rim pa bzhin mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ lā mā ljang gu/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar mo/ gzugs can ma ser mo rnams phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang bas gnas pa dang*/ mtshams rnams na bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams bum pa la gnas pa'i thod pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pa ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o// spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/

pu dzā au a go rā de mā/ kā o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ khams dang bcas pa rnams dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams su gyur pa ni/ spyi bo pul+lī ra mā la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo'o// spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa au ḍ+yan du kaṃ kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa arbu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas/ rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rīr sū ra wai ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus rā me shwa rir 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅkī dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas rnams thugs kyi 'khor lo nam mkha' la spyod pa'o// mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par aṅgu ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo ste zhing*/ lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing*/ kha ka liṅkar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ mgrin pa laṃ pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste tshan+do/ snying kāñtsir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom bar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste nye ba'i tshan+do rnams gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'o// mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā ste 'du ba/ brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭar rta mgrin dang shauṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa gnyis sau war+ṇaṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba/ sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis sin+dhur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod/

mthe bo bzhi ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tār rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod rnams sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o// thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dpa' bo rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra ba'o// rnal 'byor ma rnams gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs rdo rje phag mo lta bu'o// snying ga'i phyi skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ ring po brgyad gnas pa sgo mtshams ma rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar du khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub du khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang ro'i gdan la drag po'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan phyag mtshan dang cha lugs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lta bu'o// lha thams cad gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ sor mo la sogs pa'i gnas kyi dbye bas mang por snang yang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun nyid do// de nas bdag gi blo la snang ba'i lha sum cu so bdun po 'di dag byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang lha sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par dag go /zhes dag pa dran par bya'o// de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ zhes brjod pas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/

'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul sku rnams dang*/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku rnams dbyer med par gyur nas/ gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du dran pa lan gsum byas la/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsam mo// de nas gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la/ snying gar oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bor na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ spyi gtsug tu swa hā hu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis la bau ṣa ṭa he dpal he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ hūm̐ ho rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ yan lag rnams la phaṭa haṃ rta mchog ljang gu ste dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar hriṃ mam̐ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo bo la hreṃ hriṃ skyod byed ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag rnams la phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍī ka dud ka ste dpa' mo'i go cha bkod la/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang*/ yum gyi gnas su yab gnyis su med par bsams te/ yi ge'i rnam pa nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgom pa ni go cha dgod pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor zhing phaiṃ zhes brjod nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun du spyan drangs la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas rang la bstim nas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsam pa ni/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'o// yang sngar bzhin dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/

khro mo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur nas bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ bgegs skrod pa dang*/ mchod pa mdzad pas ye shes kyi chus lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pas gtso bo yab yum la rdo rje sems dpa'/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo la 'od dpag med/ sku yi 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod yon la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pas snga ma bzhin du mchod nas/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gsol nas tshim par bsams la/ dngos su myangs la lha thams cad kyis/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod par bsam zhing rnam lnga 'dod pas bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya ba ni nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'o// de nas lha thams cad snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam zhing 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni bde bas mnyes pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pas snga ma bzhin mchod nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpāg+ni saṃ ni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhāmabrān+dha kā ra wa pu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā ra hī baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥ.ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shāṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhe ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni/ pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ba ra hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod pa ni mchod pa'o// de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de sems mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// de nas/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi// thig le gcig la 'gyur med pa// de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la// nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur// zhes 'byung bas/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas nas/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma bkas pa tsam gyis steng du byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yungs 'bru tsam bsams pa la yid gtad de rlung kha sbyor byas pas ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// sngags zlo ba'i tshe lha rnams gsal btab nas lha kha sbyor rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba byung bas yab kyi zhal dang*/

yum gyi zhal dang*/ bha ga dang*/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'khor ba dang*/ lha mo bcu gnyis kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la g.yon skor du 'khor ba rnams kyi 'od kyis sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying ngo*// 'khor rnams kyi ni/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐/ pu dzā au a go rā de mā/ kā o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzla'o// de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa yangs par/ a las zla ba'i steng du dbus dang shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ go ku/ da/ ha/ na las ba lang*/ khyi rta/ glang po che/ mi'i sha dang*/ de'i steng du/ bi/ mu/ shu/ ma/ ra las/ dri chen/ dri chu/ byang chub kyi sems/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ rak+ta/ de'i steng du/ hūm̐/ bh+rūm̐/ kham̐/ dz+rīṃ/ ām̐ las chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ bya ba grub pa/ so sor rtog pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su bsams pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos shing me sbar ba las/ rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song nas/ oṃ dang zla ba dang sna tshogs rdo rje las bdud rtsi babs shing*/ 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba dang oṃ dang bcas pa rnams gtor ma la thim pas/

kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor dmigs la gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dur khrod brgyad kyang yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad du gyur pa ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba'i lam nas gsol bar bsams zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki n+yaḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lha'am 'khor lo'i grangs dang mnyam pas phul nas ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i phyi dang nang gis mchod nas/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo 'di dag rnams// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// 'jig rten pa la ni mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// de nas kha zas za ba'i tshe kha zas gtor ma ltar ram/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la lte ba'i gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i khrod du lha thams cad gsal bar dmigs shing lte bar 'byung po'i tshogs bsams nas/ lag pa g.yon gyi mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang*/ mdun phyogs nas g.yon skor gyis 'dab ma rnams la/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ mam̐ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ rnams dpa' mo drug dang mthe bong la sogs pa'i sen mo lnga dang*/ bsdus pa'i 'doms so rnams su/ oṃ ha/

na ma hi/ swa hā du/ bau ṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa haṃ rnams dpa' bo drug ste thams cad kyang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs par dmigs pa la/ so so'i sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang bcas zhing zhu ba dang gong bu'i rdzas kyis mchod la/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes nas tshim par bsam zhing g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su reg pas lha rnams lus la thim par bsams nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs/ kha thab khung*/ kha zas rnams bsreg rdzas su dmigs la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du bza'o// lhag ma la/ oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba lin+ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hās lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin no// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe suṃ bha'i sngags lan gnyis kyis phyogs mtshams bcings nas rang gi lus la dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dang go cha chen po rnams bkod la bdag dang snang ba thams cad he ru ka brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du shes par byas nas yul gyi lhas nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ yul rnams la sdang zhen med par spyad par bya'o// spyod lam mo// de ltar rim pa gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa bsgoms pa las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pas mthar phyin par byas pas byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams bgrod de/ nye ba'i rgyus mtshams sbyar nas rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// 'di'i brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dzā lan+dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs can/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ glog skya shes rab brtsegs/ rje mal lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/

rje btsun rin po che/ bla ma chos kyi rje rnams so// 'di ni du gal dur mis kyis// bskul ba'i don du 'phags pas sbyar// dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba rnams// he ru ka dpal nyid gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs nyung zhing gsal ba 'di ni 'phags pas/ chu mo bya'i lo sa ga'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bzhi la shing kun du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
